agents.description: Workflow coordinator and final summarizer for the onboarding bundle.
agents.system_prompt: You are the operations manager. Coordinate the workflow and drive the task to completion. Orchestrate the team: - workplace_services_admin: Owns account creation, hardware creation, and asset assignment. - policy_analyst: Verifies the onboarding SOP and standard device policy. Coordinate specialist work through the team. Synthesize worker outputs into the final onboarding completion summary.

agents.description: Owns account creation, hardware creation, and asset assignment.
agents.system_prompt: You are the workplace services admin. Follow the onboarding standard and complete the user-account, catalog-order, and asset-assignment steps.

agents.description: Verifies the onboarding SOP and standard device policy.
agents.system_prompt: You are the policy analyst. Confirm the onboarding standard and provide the policy guidance needed to complete the bundle.

goal: New hire Leah Kim starts next week. The approved onboarding packet already provides the required details: - user id target: USR-LEAH-KIM - email: leah.kim@acme.example - department: Platform Operations - location: Austin, Texas - cost center: CC-1042 The team must review the onboarding standard, create Leah's user account, order the standard laptop, create the hardware asset with serial SN-LT-9401-AUS, assign it to Leah, and return a concise completion summary.

tools.description: Read an onboarding packet or employee directory entry with identity, department, location, and cost-center context. `user_lookup` may be a packet key, proposed user ID, employee directory user ID, or normalized full name.
tools.name: read_user_directory

params.user_lookup: (str) Lookup key for the user directory. Matches packet keys, proposed user IDs, employee user IDs, or normalized full names.

tools.description: Create a new employee account in the enterprise directory. user_id format.
tools.name: create_user_account

tools.description: Read hardware and asset records including assignment, warranty, serial number, and associated cost center. `assigned_to` may be a user ID or employee name. `query` may be an asset ID, serial fragment, or other free-text filter.
tools.name: query_asset_inventory

params.assigned_to: (str) Employee name or user ID the asset is assigned to
params.query: (str) Free-text query or asset ID for asset lookup

tools.description: Create a new hardware asset record for a laptop or workplace device.
tools.name: create_hardware_asset

tools.description: Assign or transfer a hardware asset to a named employee.
tools.name: update_asset_assignment

params.assigned_to: (str) Employee name or user ID to assign to

tools.description: Submit a service-catalog equipment request such as a standard laptop or a developer workstation. requested_for format.
tools.name: order_service_catalog_item

tools.description: Retrieve incidents or change requests using a scoped query token designed for the active enterprise-management task. query is a plain record key. Do NOT use ServiceNow filter syntax.
tools.name: query_work_records

params.query: (str) Plain record key or stored query tag. Do NOT use filter syntax like 'number=X'. The backend matches record_id or query_key after stripping simple ServiceNow-style prefixes.

tools.description: Assign or re-route an incident to the correct owner or assignment group. record_id format.
tools.name: assign_work_record

params.assigned_to: (str) Employee or group to assign to

tools.description: Set planned start and end windows for a scoped change request while preserving sequencing rules. change_id format.
tools.name: schedule_change_request

tools.description: Create a downstream incident or related work record based on a report or dashboard threshold.
tools.name: create_followup_record

params.parent_record_id: (str) Optional incident/change/request ID the follow-up should be tied to
params.record_type: (str) Record type for the new follow-up, usually incident

tools.description: Retrieve enterprise SOPs and internal knowledge articles by exact stored query key, not by free-text search.
tools.name: search_knowledge_base

params.query: (str) Exact knowledge query key, not a free-text keyword or policy topic.

tools.description: Retrieve a tagged set of expense or investment lines for cleanup or budget-allocation decisions. report_id format.
tools.name: query_expense_lines

tools.description: Return the recommended retained investment lines for a tagged portfolio within the given budget. report_id format.
tools.name: optimize_budget_allocation

tools.description: Delete an expense or investment line as part of cleanup or portfolio pruning. High-risk financial write operation. expense_id format.
tools.name: delete_expense_line

tools.description: Read a dashboard metric and any associated follow-up threshold guidance.
tools.name: read_dashboard_metric
